description:
ChatStore::list() fetches all chat rows in one SQL query, then calls load_pinned_messages() in a Rust loop — one extra query per chat. For a user with N chats this is N+1 round-trips to SQLite.

The path is chat.rs:list() lines 413-419: for every ChatRow r, it calls self.load_pinned_messages(&chat_id) separately. A single LEFT JOIN against pinned_messages, or a second bulk query with an IN clause and client-side grouping, would reduce this to 2 queries regardless of chat count.

Same pattern affects find_direct_by_contact_id() (1 chat → 1 extra pinned query, low priority) and get() (acceptable).

Suggested fix for list(): after the main query collects all rows, issue one bulk SELECT chat_id, message_id FROM pinned_messages WHERE chat_id IN (...) and distribute results to the Chat objects in a HashMap pass.
title: list() makes N+1 queries for pinned messages
